title: Advanced Sensor Package Procurement
money_semantics: Report states ten FY2022 projects selected to receive $10M each from FY2022 APFIT procurement funding. Not a transaction-level obligation or payment; matching award may be counted in USAspending.
text:
1. Advanced Sensor Package Procurement
              a. Project Description: Accelerates procurement of a multi-sensor payload for use
                 in unmanned underwater vehicles that will enable safe passage of U.S. and
                 allied naval forces with advanced mine-hunting capabilities
              b. Company: Arete Associates
              c. Contract Award Date: August 22, 2022
              d. Production Quantities: Six small synthetic aperture module (SSAM) sonars and
                 18 video automatic target recognition (VATR) common module (VCM) kits
              e. Delivery Start Date: November 1, 2023 (VCM); August 1, 2024 (SSAM)
              f. Delivery End Date: September 30, 2025
              g. Delivery Rate: Eight units per month (VCM); Two units every four months
                 (SSAM);
              h. Estimated Amount of Time that APFIT Funding Accelerated the DoD
                 Capability: 24 months

              a. Project Description: Initial procurement of small antennas for resilient
                  communications that conform to platform outer mold lines. Procure and certify
                  a standalone ARMOR platform agnostic package for scalability across multi-
                  domain platforms and two pre-low rate of initial production (LRIP) network
                  certified ARMOR units ready for platform integration. Provides high data rate
                  capacity scalable to support multi-mission needs and connects the national
                  technical means to the tactical edge
              b. Company: Pacific Antenna Systems, Titan Systems LLC, and Naval Systems,
